title: Keep Your Receipts: Trustworthy Cleanup of Agent-Built Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.17719v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents build knowledge graphs as memory, and building them has become easy. Maintaining them has not. When a source is retracted, overruled, or erased, everything built on top of it (entity merges, entailed edges, community summaries) must be re-examined, and the maintainer must choose between deleting too much and too little. Deployed pipelines delete only the directly extracted facts: on our corpus that reduces contaminated queries from 32.2% to 28.0% under a real retraction and changes nothing under predicate revocation. Rebuilding is no repair for a constructor that samples: two builds of the same 300-document corpus differ in 29,475 artifacts, five times the 6,248 that removing the 61 retracted documents changes. PolyGraph instead asks the constructor for receipts: for every artifact, alternative bundles of source evidence, each claimed sufficient on its own, emitted in the call that creates it. translated_title: 保留凭证：智能体构建知识图谱的可信清理
translated_abstract: 智能体将知识图谱作为记忆来构建，如今构建它们已变得容易，维护它们却不然。当某个来源被撤回、推翻或删除时，建立在其之上的一切（实体合并、推理得出的边、社区摘要）都必须重新审查，维护者不得不在删除过多与删除过少之间抉择。已部署的流水线只删除直接提取的事实：在我们的语料库上，面对真实的撤回，这仅将受污染的查询从32.2%降至28.0%，而在谓词撤销的情况下则毫无改变。对于进行采样的构建器而言，重建也不是修复之法：同一300篇文档语料库的两次构建在29,475个产物上存在差异，是删除61篇被撤回文档所影响的6,248个产物的五倍。PolyGraph转而要求构建器提供凭证（receipts）：为每个产物提供多组可选的来源证据包，每组都声称自身即已充分，并在创建该产物的调用中一并发出。清理于是变成对这些证据包的集合运算。
tldr: PolyGraph要求知识图谱构建器在创建每个产物时发出多组可选的来源证据凭证，将图谱清理转化为基于凭证的集合运算，从而在来源被撤回或撤销时，实现远比只删除直接事实或整体重建更彻底可信的清理。
en_tdlr: PolyGraph asks knowledge graph constructors to emit receipts—alternative bundles of source evidence for every artifact at creation time—turning cleanup into set arithmetic over receipts and enabling far more trustworthy removal than pipelines that merely delete directly extracted facts or rebuild from scratch.
